findings.auditFinding: Returning to the introduction silently destroys the full plan
findings.implementation: One memory-only application session keeps plans, outcomes, history, draft notes and file-copy status across introduction, Home, help and language navigation. Continue my plan is available on the introduction. Refresh, leave and explicit clear remain the privacy boundary.

findings.auditFinding: Keeping another draft replaces previously kept checks without explaining it
findings.implementation: Kept companion drafts merge with existing checks, preserving observations and notes. App-scope replacement previews removals and supports undo.

findings.auditFinding: A valid onboarding choice can return an unexplained empty result
findings.implementation: Every concern/app combination has a next step. Missing coverage keeps the concern, explains the limitation and opens support instead of an empty plan.

findings.auditFinding: Uncommitted notes and outcome selections disappear during ordinary navigation
findings.implementation: Unrecorded outcomes and notes live in the session and encrypted file. The interface distinguishes a draft from a recorded update and offers discard.

findings.auditFinding: An allowed large Unicode plan can be exported but cannot be reopened
findings.implementation: Export and import share a 2 MB envelope bound. Maximum validated histories, Unicode and JSON-escaped notes round-trip. Oversize files fail explicitly.

findings.auditFinding: The main AI promise leads to a disabled primary action on production
findings.implementation: The working guided planner is primary. Unavailable AI actions are omitted; the demo is labelled scripted. Live AI remains disabled, with an explicit production release gate.

findings.auditFinding: Account and saving state are accurate in help, but insufficiently visible in the journey
findings.implementation: A visible tab/file-copy state explains temporary work, download started, checked copy and later edits. Setup explains no Untangle account. Walkthrough saving and provider sign-in are explicitly separate.

findings.auditFinding: The product asks a novice to learn several workspaces before receiving help
findings.implementation: A single introduction leads to concern + apps + the first instruction. Setup hides the full workspace navigation. The companion and old detailed walkthrough are optional paths.

findings.auditFinding: The companion assumes apps the person has never selected
findings.implementation: Both setup and the optional companion expose app choice, including another app and uncertainty. Requests and replies are validated against that service scope.

findings.auditFinding: The picture labelled Your selected checks does not match the kept selection
findings.implementation: The diagram uses selected draft checks or the kept plan, includes required preparation, explains its limits and shows the additional-item count. Completion-looking check marks were removed.

findings.auditFinding: A general companion note is attached to an arbitrary first check
findings.implementation: The companion note is a plan-level note, separate from check observations. It survives navigation and file export without being attached to the first check.

findings.auditFinding: People can add checks but cannot easily correct the plan's scope
findings.implementation: Checks can be removed with dependency disclosure. Apps and concerns can be edited with a removal preview. Undo remains available across internal navigation and restores mode after imports.

findings.auditFinding: Most guides stop short of helping someone who cannot find the setting
findings.implementation: Every guide has one instruction at a time and contextual help for missing settings, sign-in and restricted options. Computer-only instructions explain the device boundary. Young/family-account users are directed to help rather than bypassing controls.

findings.auditFinding: Returning another day depends on a file workflow that may exceed the audience's skills
findings.implementation: File saving provides passphrase reveal, accurate download-start feedback, a find-and-reopen rehearsal, local preview and replacement choice. Drafts and the whole-plan note are included.

findings.auditFinding: The mobile page fits, but small text and action depth undermine simplicity
findings.implementation: Readable mobile navigation and diagram text, visible first-use action, fewer setup distractions, reduced notice clutter and a sticky exit header. The selected instruction receives focus and is brought into view.

findings.auditFinding: Human and age-appropriate support is useful but too far from the first decision
findings.implementation: Human support is available from the introduction and setup. Poland offers separate youth and adult referrals. Private-image support remains age-aware without image uploads; region is selected explicitly.

findings.auditFinding: Polish UI coverage is strong, but the whole help journey is not consistently localized
findings.implementation: All added interface messages have Polish translations. A source-based coverage check catches missing literal strings and app labels. Known English-language destinations are identified. Personal text remains unchanged.

findings.auditFinding: Browser navigation does not follow the app's internal journey
findings.implementation: Browser Back traverses internal locations using opaque memory-only history keys. Notes and concerns are absent from URLs/history payloads. Page and guide headings receive focus after navigation.

findings.auditFinding: AI output checks validate structure, not preservation of the person's meaning
findings.implementation: Service-scoped validation, original/edit comparison, explicit acceptance, cancellation and undo are retained. Bilingual adversarial and semantic evaluation fixtures plus release criteria are provided. Structural tests are not presented as proof of meaning preservation; production AI stays off.

findings.auditFinding: A large initial bundle and limited page metadata create avoidable delivery work
findings.implementation: The full workspace is loaded on demand. Fonts ship only Latin and Latin Extended. Metadata supports both languages. Initial JavaScript is about 19% smaller uncompressed and 14% smaller gzipped than the audited baseline; real-device speed is not claimed.

findings.auditFinding: Security hardening and content maintenance need an explicit production baseline
findings.implementation: Production CSP and Permissions-Policy are configured. Privacy text distinguishes app data from ordinary hosting connection logs. All 13 guides have source/review records; 17 referral/source URLs returned HTTP 200. CI checks coverage, tests and links on changes, without a scheduled monitor.

findings.auditFinding: Passing feature tests do not yet demonstrate success for the intended user
findings.status: Automated coverage implemented; human study pending
findings.implementation: Regression journeys cover entry, drafts, Back/Home, language, scope edits, example separation, saving/reopening, explicit clearing and import undo across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. A ready-to-run beginner study and explicit validation gates document what remains untested.
